notes.155r.5: blóttrygill, 'sacrificial bowl', is a heathen cult vessel. The verse runs on past the unit; tegask and sveima søkkvir ('sinker of tumults', apparently a mocking name for Mar) are uncertain.

nodes.text: Something else will happen first. And with that they parted. Hallfred rode
south to his brother's, and by then his father had died,
and he was there over the winter. And in the spring, when he went north,
a snowstorm drove at them. Hallfred said it was a storm raised by sorcery. They
rode down along Vatnsdal until there was before them
a wall, and twenty men sprang up there. There had come
Mar of Marsstadir. He runs in front of Hallfred,
and Hallfred strikes at him at once, but Mar thrust a sacrificial bowl in the way,
and he was not wounded. Hallfred then rode out through the gate in the wall.
Mar called: Let us go at them! Hallfred spoke
